title: Gas Pressure and Pressure in Fluids

flashcard_questions.q: The force per unit area exerted by gas particles colliding with the walls of their container, measured in pascals (Pa).
The SI unit of pressure, equal to one newton per square metre (1 Pa = 1 N/m²).
The energy stored in the movement of particles — increasing temperature increases the kinetic energy of gas particles.
What is 1 kilopascal (kPa) equal to in pascals?

flashcard_questions.a: The amount of three-dimensional space occupied by a substance, measured in cubic metres (m³) or cubic centimetres (cm³).
